summary: Sheriff of London and Benjamin Franklin's agent, who died in Virginia in 1818; of the Sayre family but not a relative of John.
bio:
Stephen Sayre (1736–1818) served as Sheriff of London and as an agent of Benjamin Franklin. He descended from Thomas Sayre through Francis Sayre and two generations of Johns. He died in 1818 "at the residence of his son in Brandon, Virginia"; that son, Samuel W. Sayre, married Jane Grymes and Virginia Bassett.

Although he appears in the Sayre family, that branch is not part of John's ancestry, so Stephen Sayre is not a relative. The same is true of Francis B. Sayre.
